views.label: Upload to Active Governance
views.note: Documents undergo SHA256 checksum generation and security scanning before entering active circulation.

views.label: Expiry & Retention Evaluation
views.note: Approaching expiry triggers owner notification; retention policies then schedule archival or legal hold review.

views.label: Terminal Lifecycle Outcomes
views.note: Compliant documents transition to immutable archive, while unheld expired files are purged.

cards.title: Versioned Private Storage
items: All uploaded documents stored in private tenant-isolated storage
Every file modification generates an immutable version record with SHA256 checksum
Polymorphic links connect documents to Invoices, Expenses, Assets, and Employees

cards.title: Granular Sensitivity RBAC
items: Four sensitivity tiers: Public, Internal, Confidential, and Restricted
Confidential documents require elevated department permissions (e.g. Finance/Admin)
Direct disk access blocked; downloads streamed via authorized controller tokens

cards.title: Retention & Legal Hold
items: Configurable retention policies trigger automated archival or scheduled purge
Legal hold flag immediately overrides automated purge actions to prevent data loss
Configurable renewal alerts notify document owners prior to expiration dates
